newsitem.title: USA: Jacobs Engineering gets Exxon contract.
newsitem.headline: Jacobs Engineering gets Exxon contract.

text.p: Jacobs Engineering Group Inc said Tuesday it is providing engineering and procurement services to Exxon Co USA for a pipestill flexibility project at the Exxon Corp subsidiary's Baton Rouge refinery.
The total installed cost for this project is estimated at $60 million. Completion is scheduled for the fall of 1998.
The project will modify an existing crude train to increase raw material processing flexibility, the company said.

Group Vice President Tom Hammond said, "Jacobs is pleased to add this pipestill project to our work for Exxon. This is the third in a series that we have designed for the Exxon complex in the last three years."
